title: CADOC: Cache-Aware Dynamic Object Context for Long-Horizon Agents
abstract: arXiv:2609.37012v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: For a long-horizon agent, context is the bottleneck: the history is resent with every request, the window caps task length, and reasoning degrades as the history grows. Replacing structured objects with compact retrieval Cards shortens the prompt and keeps the exact originals retrievable, but editing the history can break prefix-cache reuse, and prior recoverable methods time their edits by forecasts of future reuse or by preset intervals. We propose CADOC (Cache-Aware Dynamic Object Context), an online algorithm that replaces structured objects with compact Cards while preserving exact, on-demand retrieval of their original contents. CADOC schedules replacements in batches by balancing accumulated waiting cost against shared cache-reconstruction cost. translated_title: CADOC：面向长程智能体的缓存感知动态对象上下文
translated_abstract: 对于长程智能体而言，上下文是瓶颈：历史记录会随每次请求被重复发送，上下文窗口限制了任务长度，并且随着历史的增长，推理能力会逐渐退化。用紧凑的检索卡片替换结构化对象可以缩短提示词，同时保持原始内容可被精确检索，但编辑历史可能会破坏前缀缓存的复用；而以往的可恢复方法要么通过对未来复用的预测来安排编辑时机，要么按照预设的时间间隔进行。我们提出了CADOC（缓存感知动态对象上下文），这是一种在线算法，它用紧凑的卡片替换结构化对象，同时保留对原始内容的精确、按需检索。CADOC通过权衡累积的等待成本与共享的缓存重建成本，以批处理方式调度替换操作。其调度规则源于经济订货量（EOQ）权衡，在平稳性假设下可恢复最优的整数批次大小。在各项评估中，CADOC始终取得……（原文摘要至此被截断）
tldr: CADOC是一种缓存感知的在线算法，用紧凑卡片替换长程智能体历史中的结构化对象，并通过经济订货量权衡以批量方式调度替换时机，在保持原始内容精确按需检索的同时兼容前缀缓存复用。
en_tdlr: CADOC is a cache-aware online algorithm that replaces structured objects in a long-horizon agent's history with compact Cards, scheduling replacements in batches via an economic order quantity trade-off to balance exact on-demand retrieval with prefix-cache reuse.
